entry.title: [org.webjars.npm:jquery] Potential XSS vulnerability in jQuery
entry.content:
Impact

Passing HTML from untrusted sources - even after sanitizing it - to one of jQuery's DOM manipulation methods (i.e. .html(), .append(), and others) may execute untrusted code.

Patches

This problem is patched in jQuery 3.5.0.

Workarounds

To workaround the issue without upgrading, adding the following to your code:

jQuery.htmlPrefilter = function( html ) {
    return html;
};

You need to use at least jQuery 1.12/2.2 or newer to be able to apply this workaround.

References

https://blog.jquery.com/2020/04/10/jquery-3-5-0-released/ https://jquery.com/upgrade-guide/3.5/

For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, search for a relevant issue in the jQuery repo. If you don't find an answer, open a new issue.

entry.title: [org.springframework.cloud:spring-cloud-gateway] Spring Cloud Gateway's SSL bundle configuration silently bypassed
entry.content:
When configuring SSL bundles in Spring Cloud Gateway by using the configuration property spring.ssl.bundle, the configuration was silently ignored and the default SSL configuration was used instead. Note: The 4.2.x branch is no longer under open source support. If you are using Spring Cloud Gateway 4.2.0 and are not an enterprise customer, you can upgrade to any Spring Cloud Gateway 4.2.x release newer than 4.2.0  available on Maven Centeral https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/springframework/cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/ . Ideally if you are not an enterprise customer, you should be upgrading to 5.0.2 or 5.1.1 which are the current supported open source releases.

References

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-22750
  • https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-22750
  • https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/3641
  • https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/commit/84009f2ee421e2191f8cc32ce3a84e7fc09e305e
  • https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/releases/tag/v4.2.1
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-hwqh-2684-54fc

entry.title: [org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-core] Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data vulnerability
entry.content:
Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data vulnerability in Apache Tomcat due to the fix for CVE-2026-29146 allowing the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor.

This issue affects Apache Tomcat: 11.0.20, 10.1.53, 9.0.116.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.21, 10.1.54 or 9.0.117, which fix the issue.

References

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-34486
  • https://lists.apache.org/thread/9510k5p5zdvt9pkkgtyp85mvwxo2qrly
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-69r9-qgr7-g2wj

entry.title: [org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-core] Apache Tomcat has an Improper Input Validation vulnerability
entry.content:
Improper Input Validation vulnerability in Apache Tomcat due to an incomplete fix of CVE-2025-66614.

This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.15 through 11.0.19, from 10.1.50 through 10.1.52, from 9.0.113 through 9.0.115.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.20, 10.1.53 or 9.0.116, which fix the issue.
